 Happy birthday, Scorpio and Sagittarius!
 Photo: 123rf By  Elaine Mok  -  published 26 Oct 2026 
 At a Glance Generated by AI Scorpio (24 Oct–21 Nov)
 Photo: 123rf November challenges you to balance strategy with honesty. You may be tempted to take the easy way out, or know someone who’s willing to cut corners. Define what your work and personal ethics are; know that actions have consequences, even if these consequences may be delayed. In any case, confront situations head on fearlessly. Avoiding them won’t make them go away.
 Sagittarius (22 Nov–21 Dec)
 Photo: 123rf If variety is the spice of life, then you’re the spiciest sign of all. This month, your fuel is adaptability and the ability to bring an extra dose of confidence wherever you go. Be willing to go into unfamiliar territory to get what you want. It may feel like you have to fake it until you make it, but remember: winners are made, not chosen. You’ve got the potential for a winning streak, just bring the right attitude.
 Capricorn (22 Dec–19 Jan)
 Photo: 123rf Don’t wait until Christmas to enter a season of giving . November opens the door for you to give to others what you’d like to receive in return. Whether it’s a word of encouragement or a dollar to spare, a little goes a long way. Learn to live in constant reciprocity. This also means knowing when to raise boundaries if you sense that someone or something may be draining your resources. Being kind doesn’t mean being a pushover.

 Aquarius (20 Jan–18 Feb)
 Photo: 123rf Even as everything is moving at breakneck speed around you, ease into moments of calm and inner peace. Reflection trumps action this month. You may have been moving too quickly or gotten used to living on autopilot mode. No more—learn to be more aware of what’s happening both inside and outside of you. Observe without the need to move into action, and wait for insights to follow through.
 Pisces (19 Feb–20 Mar)
 Photo: 123rf This month, instead of waiting until you’re on the brink of a burnout, take the initiative to reach out for help before the warning signs become too big to ignore. You know yourself well enough to recognise when you’re biting off more than you can chew. Remember, you don’t have to weather your struggles alone. Let people who care about you come through, especially when you’d do the same for them. 
 Aries (21 Mar–19 Apr)
 Photo: 123rf Reconnect with your special spark this month. You’re asked to do what excites you, what makes you glow. No urge is too spontaneous for you, as long as you know it’ll add some fire and colour into your life. You will feel that life is too short, and that there’s so much that you haven’t done yet. So, go ahead and start ticking things off your bucket list.
 Related article: Famous Aries Celebrities You Should Know 
 Taurus (20 Apr–20 May)
 Photo: 123rf Wherever you’re going, November blesses you with a headstart and the gift of momentum. Short travels and long journeys are within your reach. Beyond travel, you’re given the green light to make a move in any area of your life that you feel would benefit from the winds of change. The only requirement is that you know exactly where you’re headed. Dare to be decisive this month.
 Gemini (21 May–21 Jun)
 Photo: 123rf Gather your most trusted—or entertaining—group of companions around, because the theme of the month is friendship. Old friends and new friends alike take centrestage in your life, and you may find it meaningful to take more time off than usual to spend with them. No drama is too big to smooth over, and no celebration too small to ignore.  
 Cancer (22 Jun–22 Jul)
 Photo: 123rf November nudges you towards a peaceful mental state. No problem can get under your skin for long. You’re learning to set boundaries and regulate your emotions. Whenever you feel yourself getting overwhelmed, take a step back and breathe. Surround yourself with people who feel like an oasis of calm, and offer the same energy to anyone who crosses your path.
 Leo (23 Jul–22 Aug)
 Photo: 123rf November teaches you about limitations, where you usually overextend yourself, and how you can keep yourself from making the same mistakes again. Remember that you don’t always have to restrict yourself, especially if you feel like you’re up for a challenge. Moderation is key, so take stock of where you’re at and move forward with a better sense of balance.
 Related article: Famous Leo Celebrities You Should Know 
 Virgo (23 Aug–22 Sep)
 Photo: 123rf This is a month of release. The hurt, the broken dreams, the outdated aspirations. Let go and move on, slowly but surely. Be gentle with yourself, as you may be feeling a little more tender than usual. Take time off for yourself. This is a time to get in touch with difficult emotions so that they won’t have any more power over you.
 Libra (23 Sep–23 Oct)
 Photo: 123rf The theme this month is joy. Strip away the walls you have built around yourself and you’ll find that all you really want is the freedom to be happy. So, do what you love with whoever you want to do it with. Don’t think, just live and enjoy the moment. Sometimes it really is that simple.
